<div class="card-body">
'''Perimeter Scan''' is a [[Light]] [[Interrupt]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">防衛線のスキャン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：1フォース消費してロケーションに裏向きに置かれているカードを1枚覗く。2：1フォース消費して相手の手札を覗く。ドロイドのスパイか、対人地雷を見つけたら、すべて相手のユーズドデッキに移すことができる。3：「プローブ・ドロイド遠隔通信」をキャンセルする。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Perimeter-Scan-PSA-91317479.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「どうやら、帝国に居場所がバレたみたいだな」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Perimeter Scan.

'''Card text:'''
Choose one. Spend 1 Force to peek at one face-down card at a location. Spend 1 Force to peek at opponent’s hand. If you find droid spies or anti-personnel mines, you may move them all to opponent’s Used Deck. Cancel Probe Telemetry.

'''Lore:'''
Looks like the Empire has found out the location.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Game text numbers three choices after どちらかを選ぶ, uses ロケーション, 覗く, 対人地雷, ユーズドデッキ, and names Probe Telemetry as プローブ・ドロイド遠隔通信.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Perimeter Scan]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
